stem.text: The photomicrograph shows cells at different stages of mitosis.

stem.alt: Photomicrograph of plant or animal cells in different stages of division, with labels P, T, S, R and Q and leader lines to cells.

stem.text: A student wrote four statements about the photomicrograph.

items: Spindle formation is occurring in cell Q.
The amount of DNA in cell R is the same as in cell T.
The correct order for the stages is $\text{S} \rightarrow \text{R} \rightarrow \text{T} \rightarrow \text{P} \rightarrow \text{Q}$.
